messages:
april: flagging risk — the last rehearsal showed DB fetch spikes during prefix handoffs. looking for a lightweight handshake to avoid double-fetch + stale writes.
vikram: agreed. 2PC is too heavy. propose a 3-state lifecycle for entries: ACTIVE -> HANDOFF_PENDING -> HANDOFF_COMPLETE. coordinate via transfer_epoch + nonce.
maria: entries carry (transfer_epoch, nonce, state). read path checks epoch and falls back to shadow fetch when stale. simple semantics.
lee: details: on HANDOFF_PENDING mark entry read-OK but require write nonce validation. prevents stale writes without blocking reads.
cal: write validation sketch:
```
if entry.state == "HANDOFF_PENDING":
  if write.nonce != entry.nonce:
    return 409, {"Retry-After": "1s", "PF-Transfer-Epoch": entry.transfer_epoch}
  else:
    apply_write()
```
april: soft-demote instead of delete on start: set promotable=false, shorten TTL (e.g., to 10s), and push to soft-evict queue. avoids two hosts promoting simultaneously.
vikram: soft-evict queue length should be a control signal. emit pf.soft_demote_queue_len and pf.handoff_throttle_count; throttle migrations if backlog grows.
maria: TTL policy: keep soft-demoted entries for min(remaining_ttl, 30s). gives new owner time to observe before fetching.
lee: multi-key txs are tricky — if keys move mid-tx expect partial visibility. mitigation: advertise transfer windows and have client SDKs retry on 409s.
cal: add PF-Transfer-Nonce + PF-Transfer-Epoch headers on writes so SDKs can propagate and auto-retry on 409+Retry-After.
april: rollout plan: unit/integration tests -> staging dogfood with churn -> feature-flagged canary (3 tenants) -> monitor metrics for 60m windows: shadow_reads, transfer_conflicts, soft_demote_backlog, write_reject_rate -> ramp/rollback. threshold: write_reject_rate > 0.3% for 10m => rollback.
vikram: test matrix: chaos with concurrent handoff+evict+hotkeys; correctness for nonce mismatch path; stress to measure DB QPS during transfer. I'll own stress harness.
maria: i'll draft the RFC with state diagrams, lifecycle table, header names. recommend naming PF-Transfer-Epoch and PF-Transfer-Nonce.
lee: implementer tip: pack epoch<<32 | nonce into a single handoff id to simplify comparisons.
cal: ops: expose /handoff/status showing active transfers and soft_demote_queue lengths so SRE can triage.
infra-bot: created feature-flag prefetched_handoff_handshake (owners: @april, @maria). initial rollout: 3 tenants in dev, 3 in staging.
april: safety: treat missing PF-Transfer-Epoch as epoch 0 and validate writes against entry to prevent unsafeguarded clients from overwriting. push SDK update note.
vikram: per-tenant metric pf.transfer_conflicts_by_tenant so we can pause churny customers during canary.
maria: thanks all. i'll link RFC + test checklist PRs. who wants to coauthor?
lee: i'll take correctness/tests section.
cal: i'll own ops runbook.
april: closing thread — will post RFC link and checklist soon.
